description: Set HEAD_DIM to 64 so the model has 12 attention heads at the same width of 512.
Reduce WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more training time is spent at full learning rate.
Halve the total batch size to 2**18 and raise MATRIX_LR to 0.05 and EMBEDDING_LR to 0.7 to compensate for noisier gradients.
Set ASPECT_RATIO to 80 so the depth-8 model is wider (dim 640, 5 heads of 128).
Double the unembedding (lm_head) Adam learning rate from 0.004 to 0.008.
Combine UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.008 with ASPECT_RATIO 80 (dim 640, 5 heads) in one run to test whether the gains stack.
Shorten the Muon momentum warmup from 300 to 100 steps and raise the final momentum from 0.95 to 0.97.

description: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 and FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.05 for a short LR warmup and a small nonzero final LR.
Increase DEPTH from 8 to 10 (dim 640, 5 heads) with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32 to stay within memory.
Add gradient clipping at 1.0 before the optimizer step and raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06.
Lower the logit softcap from 15 to 10 in the GPT forward pass.
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 (grad accumulation 4 -> 2) so more optimizer steps fit in the 300s budget.
Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 so the learning rate ramps up briefly at the start of training.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 so the learning rate decays linearly to zero over the last 70% of training.
Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSSSSL" so only the final layer uses full context (the code already forces the last layer to long), cutting attention cost for more steps.

description: Set DEPTH from 8 to 6 (dim 384, 3 heads of 128) so a smaller, faster model gets more optimizer steps in 300 s.
Set DEPTH to 6 and ASPECT_RATIO to 96 (base dim 576 rounds up to 640, 5 heads of 128) for a shallower, wider, faster model.
Make Muon weight decay follow the LR multiplier (constant, then linear to zero in warmdown) instead of decaying linearly over the whole run.
Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine-shaped decay from 1 to FINAL_LR_FRAC over the same 50% warmdown phase.
Change ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.9, 0.99) for more Adam smoothing under the smaller batch size.
